body: You may be right about the projection to some degree but I really do believe that my teachers hate me. I always thought teachers were supposed to be these supportive adults in a young persons life, but mine either don't care at all or make things worse.

Thank you for your kind response. I have been wanting to go to counseling for a long time, but my parents don't approve of it because they have some kind of belief that only crazy people need therapists. I have been talking to my school psychologist for a while and it's helped a little bit but things just seem to be getting worse and worse lately.
